description: Dragon's Dogma 2 is set to get a Title Update later this month. Capcom has now confirmed that the update will include a 60fps patch for the game on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. Additionally, the developer has announced it is working on a Hard Mode for the game.
title: Dragon's Dogma 2 Is Getting a 60 FPS Update on Consoles and a Hard Mode Ahead of Dark Arisen Expansion

description: Amazon has announced the first tablet offers for the Great Freedom Sale 2026 before the event begins on August 7. The company has teased deals on tablets from Samsung, Lenovo, OnePlus and Xiaomi, although some sale prices have only been partially revealed. Buyers can also avail of No Cost EMI and applicable instant bank offers on eligible purchases. According to Amazon's promotional banners, the sale will bring discounts of up to 30 percent on select tablet models across different price segments.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Deals on Tablets Teased

description: Skullcandy Aviator 900 ANC is now available in India with a special introductory price tag of Rs. 24,999. The headphones have a six-microphone adaptive Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) system, along with an adjustable Stay-Aware Mode. The headphones are advertised to offer up to 60 hours of battery life with ANC turned off and up to 50 hours with ANC enabled,
title: Skullcandy Aviator 900 ANC Launched in India With Up to 60 Hours of Battery Life

description: Binance has announced the delisting of six cryptocurrencies, ACX, HFT, PIVX, PYR, VANRY, and VIC, from its platform on August 17. The exchange said the decision followed its regular review process, which evaluates factors such as liquidity, development activity, tokenomics, and regulatory compliance. Alongside spot trading, Binance will gradually discontinue futures, margin, lending, payment, and other related services for the affected tokens over the coming weeks.
title: Binance Announces Delisting of Six Tokens, Sets August 7 Futures Deadline

description: A tispter has suggested that the Oppo F35 series could launch in India around the end of August or in early September, ahead of the Flipkart Big Billion Days and Amazon Great Indian Festival sales. The same post also mentions a possible India debut for the Oppo Find X9s Pro, although the information remains unverified. Oppo has not confirmed either smartphone lineup. At present, no specifications or certification listings for the Oppo F35 series have surfaced.
title: Oppo F35 Series India Launch Tipped for Early September; Find X9s Pro Could Follow

description: OnePlus announced its Independence Day Sale 2026 in India. The sale will begin on August 7, with offers on flagship smartphones including the OnePlus 15, OnePlus 15R, and OnePlus 13s. The OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite, OnePlus Nord CE 6, OnePlus N6, and OnePlus N6x will also be available at reduced prices. Select tablets and audio devices will be offered at discounted prices in the sale.
title: OnePlus Independence Day Sale 2026 Announced: Discounts on OnePlus 15, OnePlus 15R, Nord CE 6, More

description: Fire-Boltt has confirmed that its first Boltt smartphone will launch in India on August 25 at 12pm IST through a Flipkart microsite. The teaser showcases the handset's front design and confirms that it will offer a clean software experience. Earlier leaks had suggested that the phone could debut as the Boltt Evo 4G and feature a Unisoc T7250 chipset, Android 16 and 4GB of RAM. Fire-Boltt has also confirmed plans to introduce Evo and Ace smartphone series in India.
title: Boltt Smartphone India Launch Date Announced; Flipkart Microsite Goes Live

description: Amazon has unveiled the first Smart TV offers for the Great Freedom Sale 2026 ahead of its August 7 start. The announced deals include select models from LG and TCL, while Amazon has also teased offers on Samsung, Sony and Xiaomi televisions. The company says shoppers can save up to 65 percent on Smart TVs during the sale. Eligible customers can also avail of a 10 percent instant discount on HDFC Bank Credit Card and EasyEMI transactions, alongside Free Delivery, Pay on Delivery and Easy Returns.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: Top Deals on Smart TVs Teased

description: Nasdaq-listed crypto treasury firm ZeroStack has warned that it may not be able to continue operating over the next year after reporting significant losses and a sharp decline in the value of its token holdings. The company’s latest SEC filing disclosed an $82.5 million fair value loss and highlighted uncertainty over its financial position, marking a reversal from its more optimistic outlook issued just three months ago.
title: ZeroStack Faces Survival Challenge After Posting $82.5 Million Loss

description: Amazon's Great Freedom Sale will begin on August 7, and the e-commerce platform has started teasing some of the laptop deals ahead of the event. Companies like Lenovo, HP, Dell, and Asus will offer the latest laptops at discounted prices. Now, here's a look at the best deals on laptops.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Laptop Deals Teased Ahead of Sale

description: Vivo has revealed the specifications of the upcoming Vivo S2. It is confirmed to be available in Regal Bronze, Sapphire Blue and Silk White colour options. The upcoming phone will run on a MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo processor and include a 7,050mAh battery. It will have a 6.83-inch 3D Curved AMOLED display with 1.5K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Vivo S2 Key Specifications Confirmed Ahead of August 6 India Launch: 7,050mAh Battery, Dimensity 7360 Turbo, and More

description: Sony has said that it doesn't expect any negative impact on its gaming business due to its move to end disc production in 2028. The company's CFO said there had been no impact on business after the plan was announced. The PlayStation parent will stop making discs for new games starting January 2028.
title: Sony Doesn't Expect Any Negative Impact on Gaming Business After Ending Disc Production

description: A new leak suggests that Oppo is testing the Find X10 Ultra with a 200-megapixel LOFIC main camera and a 200-megapixel telephoto camera featuring upgraded image stabilisation. Tipster Smart Pikachu also claims the flagship could be priced in the CNY 10,000 segment (roughly Rs. 1,41,000), placing it close to the Oppo Find N6 foldable. Earlier reports have pointed to a dual periscope camera setup, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset, a 6.89-inch LTPO display and an approximately 8,500mAh battery.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Leak Hints at 200MP Camera Upgrade, Premium Price Tag

description: iQOO Neo 11S could launch soon in China as a new leak detailing its specifications has leaked online. It is tipped to run on a customised version of MediaTek's Dimensity 9500 chipset. It could feature a 2K resolution display, and the panel could be manufactured using a new domestic display technology. The battery capacity of the iQOO Neo 11S is said to be over 9,000mAh.
title: iQOO Neo 11S Leak Hints at Bigger Battery, Custom Dimensity 9500 SoC

description: Sony Bravia 9 II 115-inch True RGB TV was launched in India on Monday as the latest addition to its Bravia 9 II lineup. It is the company's largest TV to date and joins the existing 75-inch and 75-inch variants. The TV is powered by Sony’s proprietary RGB Backlight Master Drive Pro technology. Alongside the flagship 115-inch model, the company has also introduced a new 98-inch option to its Bravia 7 II lineup.
title: Sony Bravia 9 II 115-inch True RGB TV Launched in India With Backlight Master Drive Pro Tech: Price, Specifications

description: Poco M8 Power will be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter, the tech firm confirmed a day before the phone's launch in India. The soon-to-be-launched Poco M8 Power will be available for purchase in India in three colour options, namely Black, Blaze Orange, and Green. The tech firm claims that it will also ship with an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance. The Poco M8 Power is now confirmed to feature LPDDR4x RAM and UFS 2.2 onboard storage. The display of the smartphone will offer Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. It will ship Xiaomi’s Android 16-based HyperOS 3, and the smartphone maker promises four OS upgrades and six years of security patches for the Poco M8 Power. The phone will sport a matte rear panel and a metal frame, too.
title: Poco M8 Power Camera Configuration, Colour Options, and More Details Confirmed Ahead of Launch

description: The growing number of AI-generated bug reports has reportedly prompted Apple to limit security submissions. Cybersecurity firm Bynario reportedly states that it discovered more than 50 potential security flaws in Apple's macOS operating system within three weeks, including a privilege escalation chain that could allow attackers to take full control of a Mac. As AI speeds up vulnerability discovery, Apple still needs to manually verify each report before issuing a fix.
title: Apple Caps Security Bug Reports Amid Surge in AI-Generated Findings: Report

description: The Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G was launched in India on Monday. The handset arrives as the second addition to the Galaxy F70 lineup, which already comprises the Galaxy F70e 5G, introduced in February. It sports a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The handset has a triple rear camera system, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter. It packs a 6,000mAh battery with 45W wired fast charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G Launched in India With Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 Chip, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Galaxy Digital’s head of research, Alex Thorn, has warned of a suspected fourth wave of attacks targeting vulnerable Coldcard Bitcoin wallets. The latest activity involves 709 potential victim addresses and nearly 449 Bitcoin, with attackers moving funds to separate destination wallets. Thorn urged affected users to transfer their holdings immediately using higher transaction fees, following last week’s $38 million Coldcard exploit linked to flawed wallet key generation.
title: Researchers Warn of New Bitcoin Wallet Attacks as 448 BTC Is Swept From Hundreds of Addresses

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will be launched next year with a triple rear camera unit, according to a report. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will reportedly feature a 200-megapixel primary rear camera, paired with a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera. However, while the Galaxy S27 Ultra will reportedly boast a 50-megapixel telephoto camera with up to 5x optical zoom capabilities, the Pro model is said to sport a 12-megapixel telephoto shooter with up to 3x optical zoom.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro, Galaxy S27 Ultra Leak Hint at a Triple Rear Camera System, Different Telephoto Shooters

description: The Amazon Great Freedom Sale is set to begin soon as the e-commerce giant's latest Independence Day-themed sale event in India. Ahead of the sale, Amazon has teased deals on projectors. Beginning August 7, the e-commerce giant will offer discounts on portable home projectors, Google TV projectors, and Android LED projectors. Customers will be able to purchase products from brands such as Lumio, boAt, Zebronics, Crossbeats, WZATCO, and Lifelong Electronics at considerably lower prices than their usual market rates.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: Deals on Projectors From Boat, Lumio, Zebronics and More Teased

description: Oppo has officially announced that the A7 Pro Max will go official in China on August 4. Now, the company has shared new teasers revealing the camera details of the phone. It is confirmed to come with a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 50-megapixel main camera. It will run on ColorOS 16 based on Android 16. The upcoming handset will have an IP69K rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Rear Camera Details Confirmed Ahead of August 4 Launch

description: Amazon has started teasing the best deals on smartphones that will be available during the upcoming Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026. The recently launched Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, the company’s flagship book-style foldable, will be available at a discounted price of Rs. 1,90,999, instead of its listed price of Rs. 1,99,999. This means that buyers will be able to save up to Rs. 9,000. Similarly, the flagship OnePlus 15, which is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, will be listed during the Amazon Great Freedom Sale at Rs. 81,999, while it usually retails at Rs. 89,999. The smartphone features a triple rear camera system. Apart from this, the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and Samsung Galaxy M47 5G will also be available during the sale event at relatively low prices, the e-commerce giant has confirmed.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: Top Deals on Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy S25 Ultra, OnePlus 15 and More Teased

description: In Europe, the prices for 512GB and 1TB Xbox Series S/X models have gone up by EUR 150 and EUR 200. The 512GB Xbox Series S model now costs EUR 499.99, up from the previous EUR 349.99. The 1TB model, which was previously EUR 399.99, is now EUR 599.99.
title: Xbox Price Hike Goes Into Effect, 1TB Xbox Series S/X Consoles Now Cost EUR 200 More in Europe

description: Bitcoin traded above $62,000 on Monday as lower oil prices and whale accumulation provided support despite weak spot Bitcoin ETF demand. Analysts said subdued institutional participation and upcoming US economic data could determine whether the cryptocurrency can reclaim the $64,000-$65,000 range.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $62,600 as Weak ETF Demand Keeps Crypto Market Under Pressure

description: Samsung is expected to refresh its flagship tablet lineup later this year with the Galaxy Tab S12 series. While the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to announce an official launch date, the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has now surfaced on a benchmarking platform, which reveals its key hardware specifications and benchmark scores. The purported Samsung tablet is listed with MediaTek's flagship Dimensity chipset. It could ship with at least 12GB of RAM, running on Android 17.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Surfaces on Geekbench With Dimensity 9500 Chip, Android 17

description: iQOO Z11, which is set to launch in India soon, will sport a notably different design than its Chinese counterpart, the company has revealed. The iQOO Z11 is teased to launch with a pill-shaped rear camera island, featuring a dual camera unit and an LED ring light, which is claimed to be a “flagship-inspired design”. It is confirmed to sport a premium matte finish rear panel, too. Similarly, the iQOO Z11 will also feature a 3D curved display and a thin frame. A speaker grille and a microphone will be placed on the top of the phone, too. Meanwhile, a power button and volume controls appear on the right side of the handset.
title: iQOO Z11 Teased to Launch in India With a Redesigned Camera Module, 3D Curved Display

description: Two Oppo Find X10 series smartphones have reportedly received network access approval in China, according to a tipster. The listing suggests support for the N79 5G band, 2.4GHz spread spectrum communication and ColorOS 17 with multiple on-device AI models. The tipster also reiterates that the flagship lineup is expected to launch in late September. Earlier leaks have hinted at a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, upgraded cameras, a redesigned display and a battery exceeding 8,000mAh on the Pro model.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Receives China Network Certification, Reveals New Software Details

description: The Made by Google event is less than two weeks away, where the Pixel 11 series is expected to be unveiled. The Mountain View-based tech giant has begun teasing its upcoming smartphone lineup, but there may not be much left to reveal. Complete specifications and expected US and European pricing for all four upcoming models, the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, have been leaked.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series Complete Specifications, US and Europe Prices Reportedly Leak Ahead of Launch

description: Apple is currently exploring ways to bring health and fitness tracking capabilities to its smart glasses and AR headsets, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman claims. However, the tech giant reportedly does not plan to bring the said functionalities with the first-generation smart glasses, which are expected to launch next year. With the future smart glasses, Apple will reportedly equip the wearable with a “range of sensors” to record health and fitness-related data and the user’s movements to offer the functionalities. The company is said to be currently exploring different ways it can implement this with the smaller form factor of smart glasses.
title: Apple Plans to Turn Future Smart Glasses, Headsets Into Health and Fitness Tracking Devices: Report

description: Reliance Jio has introduced the JioTag 2 in India as the successor to the original tracking device released in 2023. The new model supports both Google's Find Hub and Apple's Find My services, enabling Android and iOS users to locate tagged belongings through their preferred ecosystem. It features Bluetooth Low Energy connectivity, a 120dB buzzer, Lost Mode, an IP64-rated body and a replaceable battery. The tracker is available in three colour options for Rs. 1,249.
title: JioTag 2 Launched in India With Google Find Hub and Apple Find My Support: Price, Features

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone is widely rumoured to launch later this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to confirm its plans, a seasoned journalist believes it could be the company’s most expensive iPhone model to date. To make it more accessible to prospective buyers, Apple is reported to offer the purported foldable, known as the iPhone Ultra, via the recently announced Apple Upgrade leasing programme.
title: iPhone Ultra to Reportedly Cost Over $2,000; Apple Upgrade Could Lower Monthly Payments

description: Redmi K100 Pro Max will be powered by an optimised version of the flagship octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, according to a report citing gaming benchmark results shared by “NewReviewTech” (translated from Chinese) on Weibo. The Snapdragon 8 series SoC will reportedly be paired with a dedicated D2 graphics chip to further enhance the gaming performance. On top of this, the Redmi K100 Pro Max is said to launch with a 9,070mAh battery, along with “other” new hardware configurations.
title: Redmi K100 Pro Max Chipset, Battery and Other Specifications Spotted in Gaming Test Results
